key_insight: LOKI discovers row-level join paths across disjoint tables by using text as the bridge, turning implicit cross-table evidence into explicit, typed integrations.
engineering_relevance: It enables data-lake integration when schemas and direct join keys are missing, making heterogeneous data much easier to combine with provenance.
method: Builds a horizontal bidirectional cross-attention model over table rows and sentences.
Learns contextualized row-sentence representations with a global table-text contrastive objective.
Groups discovered links into relation-consistent, typed integrated tables with sentence-level provenance.
evidence_signal: On real-world benchmarks, the method outperforms prior multi-modal discovery approaches and reaches 0.982 macro typed-pair precision, while being up to 40× cheaper than direct LLM prompting.
watch_item: Performance depends on available text evidence, so sparse, noisy, or ambiguous documents may reduce join-path discovery quality.
paper_title: Discovery-Driven Integration of Disjoint Tables via Text
